title: VendPoint Badge Users, Daily Vend Limits and Cost Center Billing Allowances
content:
Account set-up allowances of the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program, by machine model.

- **Badge users included**: active badge users without a badge fee. **Additional badge fee**: monthly fee per active badge user above the included number, USD. **Replacement badge card fee**: fee per replacement badge card issued, USD.
- **Daily vend limit**: default units one badge may vend per day unless the customer sets another limit.
- **Cost center billing**: whether vends are billed separately per customer cost center. **Maximum cost centers**: largest number of cost centers a machine may bill to; 0 means billing is per machine only.

| | VendPoint Locker 12 | VendPoint Locker 24 | VendPoint Coil 40 | VendPoint Coil 60 | VendPoint Carousel 90 | VendPoint Smart Crib 300 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Badge users included | 25 | 50 | 100 | 150 | 250 | 1000 |
| Additional badge fee, USD per user per month | 1.50 | 1.50 | 1.25 | 1.25 | 1.00 | 0.50 |
| Replacement badge card fee, USD | 5.00 | 5.00 | 5.00 | 4.00 | 4.00 | 3.00 |
| Daily vend limit, units per badge | 10 | 10 | 15 | 15 | 20 | 25 |
| Cost center billing | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Maximum cost centers | 0 | 10 | 25 | 50 | 100 | 500 |

### Points of reading

- The VendPoint Locker 12 bills per machine only: cost center billing "no" and a maximum of 0 cost centers.
- The daily vend limit is a default; it is the figure that applies where the customer has set no other limit.

### Hypothetical illustration

A VendPoint Coil 40 with 110 active badge users in a month has 10 users above the 100 included, giving 10 times 1.25 USD, that is 12.50 USD, for the month. The user count is an example only.
